# `matter/coupling/MatterCouplingScheduler.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/coupling/MatterCouplingScheduler.js`

Deterministic, fail-closed orchestration for one coupled Matter state update.

## Classes

### `class MatterCouplingScheduler`

Execute the bound portion of an explicit dependency plan exactly once. The scheduler returns a candidate state and receipt; durable commit remains the MatterStateStore authority.
